subject: Mathematics
mastery_rule: Skill = Secure when all its questions are correct on two consecutive tests; Emerging when >=50%; Not yet otherwise

skills.name: Read, write, compare and round whole numbers to 1,000,000
Add and subtract multi-digit numbers with regrouping
Multiplication facts to 12 x 12 (fluent, under 3 s each)
Multiply 3–4 digit by 1 digit and 2 digit by 2 digit
Divide up to 4 digit by 1 digit, including remainders
Factors, multiples, prime and composite numbers
Equivalent fractions; compare; add/subtract like denominators
Decimals to hundredths; relate to fractions; compare
Multi-step word problems with all four operations
Choose a strategy, show working, check reasonableness of an answer
Explain reasoning in words using correct maths vocabulary
Place-value patterns: a digit is 10x the place to its right, 1/10 of the place to its left
Read, write and compare whole numbers to billions (standard, word, expanded form)
Properties of operations: commutative, associative, distributive
Powers of 10 and exponents; multiply by 10, 100, 1000 using patterns
Relate multiplication and division; use inverse to check
Write a numerical expression from words and vice versa
Evaluate expressions using order of operations, including parentheses and brackets
